limits: These are postal-area codes represented in the Hamburg dataset, not proof that every address bearing each code lies in Hamburg or is deliverable.
The official dataset includes border-area codes such as 21217, 22869 and 22885 and the island code 27499. Do not silently substitute a contiguous numeric range.
A user can enter Hamburg beside an unrelated or nonexistent street. City text plus postcode is only screening, not address verification.
Dataset publication/metadata timestamps are not a guarantee that every geographic boundary is current; keep source attribution and refresh the list.

recommendedValidation.initial: Require a full street address and house number, a five-digit postcode from the official list, and the explicit city Hamburg. Keep an order subject to address/fee confirmation if no authoritative address lookup is implemented.
recommendedValidation.stronger: Match the full address against Hamburg’s daily updated official Zentraler AdressService; it is maintained for the city’s official addresses and offers an OGC API with a simplified schema. Only accept an unambiguous address match.
recommendedValidation.fallback: If the service is unavailable or a valid new address is missing, require manual restaurant confirmation rather than silently claiming successful validation.
recommendedValidation.commercialServiceArea: Even a valid Hamburg address is not automatically a restaurant delivery commitment. The owner must define reachable areas and exclusions, including special/island locations.
recommendedValidation.pricing: Retain quote mode until the owner supplies and confirms the fee formula. Display delivery price as pending, not free or zero. Do not request final payment before the agreed total is known.
